# Codex GIF Video

> Agent Skill for silent native GIF and MP4 visual assets. Skill name: codex-gif-video.

- Main task: turn action briefs or narration text into short native GIF shots; optionally join them into one long GIF or silent MP4.
- 中文用途: 动作素材、长 GIF、静音 MP4、人物一致性、风格参考；不添加字幕、配乐、配音或音效。
- Entry: copy codex-gif-video/ to the Agent skill directory; invoke $codex-gif-video.
- Generation: enabled Codex native GIF tool or explicitly authorized official OpenAI API. Account/model availability is required; API usage may be billed.
- Export: one original cycle per shot, no speed changes, no interpolation, no looping to fill duration. Retain original GIF bytes and provenance.
- Style references: 66 guides from Lemomo / Lemo-Opuscar plus 3 presets; not all styles render-tested.
- Limits: perceptual checks may remain unknown; cross-style costume color preservation has a known failed example. Original model response identity may be unreported.
